name: HealthBeam – Advanced WordPress Diagnostics, Monitoring & Site Health Tools
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
🚀 Premium Addons for Your Store:
* Conditional Store Restrictions (PRO) – The ultimate access control engine for WooCommerce.
* Price & Cart Hider (PRO) – Professional Catalog Mode & B2B pricing control.

HealthBeam by VerseSofts provides a comprehensive suite of professional diagnostic and monitoring tools designed to help you maintain, debug, and optimize your WordPress performance. Built with a modern, fast React dashboard, it offers a deep look into your system’s health without requiring technical overhead.

Site stability is paramount for any growing business. HealthBeam empowers Administrators and developers to identify errors, verify file integrity, and test server configurations instantly, ensuring your site remains secure and operational at all times.

✨ Core Features for Site Optimization

  • Real-Time Debug Log Viewer: Monitor your WordPress debug log (WP_DEBUG_LOG) live as errors occur directly in your dashboard.
  • File Integrity Checker: Automatically verify your WordPress core files against official checksums to identify modified or missing files instantly.
  • Mail Configuration Tester: Send targeted test emails to verify your SMTP or mail configuration is functioning correctly.
  • Plugin Compatibility Checker: Analyze all installed plugins for PHP version compatibility and system requirement alignment.
  • System Configuration Viewers: Access and view critical files like .htaccess, robots.txt, and your full PHP configuration (phpinfo).
  • Transient & Cache Manager: Monitor and clean up database transients to reduce bloat and optimize database performance.
  • Modern React Interface: Fast, responsive, and intuitive user experience that integrates flawlessly with the WordPress Site Health screen.

💼 Perfect For

  • Developers: Debug and troubleshoot complex WordPress issues with real-time logging and file verification.
  • Site Administrators: Proactively monitor site health, system configuration, and mail delivery status.
  • Support Teams: Quickly diagnose client site problems by accessing detailed system diagnostics in one click.
  • Maintenance Agencies: Use a professional toolset to keep multiple WordPress installations running at peak performance.

Why Choose VerseSofts?

We build professional-grade tools to help your WordPress site scale. Explore our full range of solutions on our Official WooCommerce Marketplace Profile.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for HealthBeam.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to Tools > Site Health > Advanced Tools to access your new diagnostic dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the tools after activation?

Navigate to Tools > Site Health in your WordPress admin, then click on the Advanced Tools tab to see your dashboard.

Do we need to enable WP_DEBUG_LOG?

Yes, you need to enable WP_DEBUG_LOG in your wp-config.php file. The plugin provides safe instructions on how to do this.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s latest speed and architecture standards, including HPOS.
